The '''V-wing Speeder Transport, Model B''' was an updated model of the [[V-wing Speeder Transport, Model A|Model A]] produced by [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil]] and used to transport [[V-wing airspeeder]]s into battle. It was longer than the Model A, measuring 27 [[Meter/Legends|meters]], and had an internal cargo capacity of four [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]]. The main difference was that the Model B could transport six V-wing airspeeders and their pilots into battle, rather than the Model A's four.
